title: Two-Orbit Packing for Exact State Complexity of Explicit Binary Consensus in Anonymous Dynamic Networks with Periodic Time
creator: Yonezu, Ryutaro
description: We study deterministic binary consensus with explicit termination in anonymous synchronous 1-interval-connected dynamic networks under one-bit broadcast-counting communication with a free globally aligned phase phi_t=t mod P. For known dynamic diameter D and unknown network size, we prove the exact persistent-state complexity S_D(D,P)=ceil(D/P)+2, equivalently P(S-2)>=D. The three-state threshold is exactly P>=D. The same two-orbit packing argument strengthens the known-size lower bound to 2+ceil(floor(n/2)/P). The preprint is not peer reviewed.
